_description: Common medical billing errors and their detection patterns. Used by AnalyzerAgent cross-reference.

A_upcoding.name: CPT Code Upcoding
A_upcoding.description: Provider billed a higher-level code than the service justified
examples: ER visit billed as level 5 (99285) when vitals and documentation suggest level 3 (99283)
Office visit billed as level 5 (99215) for a simple prescription refill
A_upcoding.detection: Compare billed CPT level to documentation. Medicare rate ratio > 3x for that code = suspicious.

B_duplication.name: Duplicate Charges
B_duplication.description: Same procedure or service billed more than once for the same date
examples: CBC panel billed twice on same day
Same X-ray billed by both hospital and radiologist
B_duplication.detection: Exact match on CPT code + date of service + amount.

C_unbundling.name: Unbundling
C_unbundling.description: Multiple separate codes used instead of a single bundled code
examples: 80048 (basic panel) + individual tests instead of 80053 (comprehensive panel)
Multiple wound repair codes instead of one complex repair code
C_unbundling.detection: Multiple CPT codes that are in a known bundled set in cpt_codes.json.

D_facility_fees.name: Excessive Facility Fees
D_facility_fees.description: Hospital facility fee charged for routine office visit or service that didn't require hospital setting
examples: $500 facility fee for a 10-minute office consultation
ER-level facility fee for a scheduled outpatient lab test
D_facility_fees.detection: Line item with 'facility' or 'hospital' modifier on routine CPT codes. Amount > 2x the professional fee.

E_medication_pricing.name: Medication/Supply Markups
E_medication_pricing.description: Generic medications or supplies billed at brand-name or excessive prices
examples: Standard IV saline bag billed at $200
E_medication_pricing.detection: Medication/Supply item descriptions with common generic names. Price >> reasonable range. Flag if > $50 for common generics.

F_quantity_errors.name: Quantity Errors
F_quantity_errors.description: Incorrect quantity billed — too many units, days, or doses
examples: 3 physical therapy units for a 15-minute session
5 days of hospitalization billed for a 2-day stay
F_quantity_errors.detection: Compare billed quantity to billing_frequency limits for that CPT code.

G_out_of_network.name: Out-of-Network / Surprise Billing
G_out_of_network.description: Charges from out-of-network providers at in-network facilities (No Surprises Act protections may apply)
examples: ER physician out-of-network at in-network hospital emergency room
G_out_of_network.detection: Multiple providers on same bill with different network status noted. Emergency services flagged.
